addition.item: The default image is optional: without an image the masthead shows only its text, and nothing at all when there is no text either
Image and title of a menu based masthead are optional: left empty, they are taken from the default masthead

security.item: All masthead output is escaped, including titles, descriptions, classes and image URLs from articles
Button URLs with javascript:, vbscript: or data: are rejected when saving and never output
Title tag, text position and visibility only accept their listed values

fix.item: With caching enabled every page showed the same masthead; caching is now per page
Article Browser Page Title now works as description source
The article is loaded once per page, and the article override also works without menu based mastheads
Missing article images, unpublished or restricted articles and missing menu items no longer cause warnings or show restricted content
Remote article images are no longer fetched and keep their URL
A description with text like <b> in it is shown as typed instead of losing that text when shortened
Hiding the title no longer leaves an empty heading; hide always outputs no heading at all
The button always gets the Bootstrap btn class, so button styles work on every template
The aspect ratio also works on Bootstrap 5 templates other than Cassiopeia
Minimum and maximum height accept whole numbers only, up to 2000 px

addition.item: Button URLs can be mailto:, tel: and other app links, and internal index.php links are routed to SEF URLs
Multiple buttons per masthead, each with its own text, link and class; an existing button becomes the first one
Usage information on the Module tab
The default title is optional: leave it empty for a default masthead with only an image, while menu based mastheads keep their own title

change.item: Requires Joomla 5.4 or 6 and PHP 8.1 or newer
Rebuilt on the Joomla 5/6 module architecture (service provider, Dispatcher, WebAssetManager stylesheet)

language.item: Dutch: missing strings added, module description and typos fixed

addition.item: Option to add button below the description
Ability to hide title or description on all screen sizes.

fix.item: Masthead global settings for description "image alt" and "image caption" were ignored.
NL Language for new priority button.
Menu item mastheads were overwritten by article content.

change.item: Set the limit for menu mastheads from 10 to 50.

addition.item: Ability to set article image priority to intro image or full article image.

remove.item: Note option has been removed from masthead description source. This never worked.

fix.item: Fixed a bug with php 8 and the way i called stdClass in the helper.

addition.item: I've added a new feature! It is now possible to hide the title and/or description for your mastheads on xs, sm and md sized screens.
ability to add your own class to main div
option to define what is used for description when blog layout -> single article is viewed.
I've added a missing option to set the max length of the description text. This is needed because we take the article text as description in the single article view on a blog layout.
